skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Shining Dew SDm11
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Shining Dew Series SDm11 for men. Tight-fitting, lightweight, breathable, and designed for the summer.
skins.quote: Imagine NOT wearing something that shows off this beautiful physique in the summer. What a waste.

skins.name: Snowy Echo
skins.content: One of Elysium's Numerous Outfits as a Messenger/Snowy Echo. Many associate the pairing of red and white with the bygone Icefield Messenger. Perhaps to pander to their expectations, he's matched it with a pair of spectacles on purpose.
skins.quote: From far, far away, you can see a completely different Elysium. Want the normal one? Just start talking with him.
